label: syslog-ng Store Box 3000 log collector
description: 1U purpose-built log collection appliance running syslog-ng that ingests syslog over UDP/TCP/TLS from network devices and servers, indexes and stores it in a compressed encrypted archive with retention policies, then forwards it onward. Four 1GbE RJ45 data ports carry the external, management, internal and HA roles, with an additional dedicated IPMI LAN port and a serial console.
notes: Installation guide: 'NIC: 2 x 1GBase-T Ethernet ports via onboard Intel I210-AT' + '4 x 1GBase-T Ethernet ports via Supermicro AOC-SGP-i4', plus 'Dedicated IPMI LAN port'. One Identity port-mapping KB: on the SSB 3000, ports 1-4 map to eth0 (external), eth1 (management), eth2 (internal, unused) and eth3 (HA); the remaining two onboard RJ45 ports are unused. The SSB 3500 adds 2x 10G SFP+.
